mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal (FEDFUNDS decline), or the federal funds rate rises within 3 months after the start of the decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, raising discount rates on equity valuations and compressing future cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the rate increase, or the rate remains above 4.5% for less than 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward trends in GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal robust demand and supply conditions, boosting market confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in > 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and INDPRO are rising, or the co-movement between the two proxies is weak (Rank IC < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, simultaneous high GDP growth (GDPC1) and low unemployment (UNRATE) signal robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in > 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and UNRATE are high, or the combination does not predict returns in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in industrial production (INDPRO) above 107.2433 signals robust supply-side activity, boosting market confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in > 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 107.2433, or the production surge is temporary (INDPRO falls below threshold within 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions, fostering investor optimism and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 3.5%, or the rate improvement is reversed within 2 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movement in GDP growth (GDPC1) and downward movement in unemployment (UNRATE) signals robust demand and labor market improvements, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 rises and UNRATE falls, or the co-movement between the two proxies is weak (Rank IC < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery regime, simultaneous high federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal controlled monetary policy, stabilizing markets and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-shock recovery regime, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in > 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL meet the criteria, or the combination does not predict returns in out-of-sample testing.
